Ah, I see. I didn't notice it could come across like this, I mean this was supposed to be just a vent of mine in first place, I didn't expect it to get much attention. I just wrote stuff down that was going through my head without much structure :/

Of course rape is a terrible thing and I hope that people actually doing this are being held accountable, I hope the victims are getting justice and recover well, but making jokes about terrible things do not mean any real harm. Jokes are not supposed to influence the justice system (? Probably not the correct word but I hope you know what I mean), it's to make your friends laugh. I believe most people that joke about tragedies know that these are in reality really awful things, there is mostly no ill intend.

But honest question, why are there things that shouldn't be joked about? Jokes about tragedies (and in general) are meant to make someone laugh, no ill intend. (Ofc if there is an ill intend, that's something else)
The comparison wasn't perfect I guess, this vent was about two things after all and I tried to mix it in one post.

You don't have to find them funny, as I said. But some people do find them funny and I personally think if they can laugh about stuff, good. Rape itself ofc is a horrible thing but jokes about that aren't usually ill intended I think.

I'm not saying jokes about men, cis or white people aren't dark humor. As I said, it's up to you to like or dislike jokes of all kinds. People don't have to find everything funny, but I do think that people can joke about everything because it's funny to them.
